t: 埃尔南·科尔特斯抵达墨西哥寻找阿兹特克文明及其财富。
te: Hernán Cortés arrives in Mexico in search of the Aztec civilization and its wealth.
dz: 埃尔南·科尔特斯抵达墨西哥寻找阿兹特克文明及其财富。
de: Hernán Cortés arrives in Mexico in search of the Aztec civilization and its wealth.

t: 埃尔南·科尔特斯进入塔巴斯科省，击败当地的印第安人。
te: Hernán Cortés, entering province of Tabasco, defeats Tabascan Indians.
dz: 埃尔南·科尔特斯进入塔巴斯科省，击败当地的印第安人。
de: Hernán Cortés, entering province of Tabasco, defeats Tabascan Indians.

t: 西班牙征服者埃尔南·科尔特斯在墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯建立定居点。
te: Spanish conquistador Hernán Cortés establishes a settlement at Veracruz, Mexico.
dz: 西班牙征服者埃尔南·科尔特斯在墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯建立定居点。
de: Spanish conquistador Hernán Cortés establishes a settlement at Veracruz, Mexico.

t: 查理五世被选为神圣罗马帝国皇帝.
te: Charles V is elected Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire.
dz: 查理五世被选为神圣罗马帝国皇帝.
de: Charles V is elected Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire.

t: 朱陈豪宣布明朝正德皇帝为篡位者,起事于宁太子叛乱,并率军北上,想夺取南京.
te: Zhu Chenhao declares the Ming dynasty's Zhengde Emperor a usurper, beginning the Prince of Ning rebellion, and leads hi…
dz: 朱陈豪宣布明朝正德皇帝为篡位者,起事于宁太子叛乱,并率军北上,想夺取南京.
de: Zhu Chenhao declares the Ming dynasty's Zhengde Emperor a usurper, beginning the Prince of Ning rebellion, and leads his army north in an attempt to capture Nanjing.

t: 斐迪南·麦哲伦的五艘船从塞维利亚起航，开始环球航行。巴斯克第二号指挥官胡安·塞巴斯蒂安·埃尔卡…
te: Ferdinand Magellan's five ships set sail from Seville to circumnavigate the globe. The Basque second-in-command Juan Se…
dz: 斐迪南·麦哲伦的五艘船从塞维利亚起航，开始环球航行。巴斯克第二号指挥官胡安·塞巴斯蒂安·埃尔卡诺将在麦哲伦在菲律宾去世后完成这次探险。
de: Ferdinand Magellan's five ships set sail from Seville to circumnavigate the globe. The Basque second-in-command Juan Sebastián Elcano will complete the expedition after Magellan's death in the Philippines.

t: 巴拿马城 巴拿马成立.
dz: 巴拿马城 巴拿马成立.

t: 第三天出战,哲学家和将领王阳明击败了朱全忠,结束了宁国太子反对明朝正德皇帝统治的叛乱.
te: On the third day of battle, philosopher and general Wang Yangming defeats Zhu Chenhao, ending the Prince of Ning rebell…
dz: 第三天出战,哲学家和将领王阳明击败了朱全忠,结束了宁国太子反对明朝正德皇帝统治的叛乱.
de: On the third day of battle, philosopher and general Wang Yangming defeats Zhu Chenhao, ending the Prince of Ning rebellion against the reign of the Ming dynasty's Zhengde Emperor.

t: 费迪南德·麦哲伦 (Ferdinand Magellan) 与大约 270 名探险队员从桑卢卡…
te: Ferdinand Magellan sets sail from Sanlúcar de Barrameda with about 270 men on his expedition which ultimately culminate…
dz: 费迪南德·麦哲伦 (Ferdinand Magellan) 与大约 270 名探险队员从桑卢卡尔德巴拉梅达 (Sanlúcar de Barrameda) 起航，最终完成了首次环球航行。
de: Ferdinand Magellan sets sail from Sanlúcar de Barrameda with about 270 men on his expedition which ultimately culminates in the first circumnavigation of the globe.

t: 埃尔南·科尔特斯进入特诺奇蒂特兰，阿兹特克统治者蒙特祖玛以盛大的庆祝活动欢迎他。
te: Hernán Cortés enters Tenochtitlán and Aztec ruler Moctezuma welcomes him with a great celebration.
dz: 埃尔南·科尔特斯进入特诺奇蒂特兰，阿兹特克统治者蒙特祖玛以盛大的庆祝活动欢迎他。
de: Hernán Cortés enters Tenochtitlán and Aztec ruler Moctezuma welcomes him with a great celebration.
